comment: Single source of truth for the duplication threshold -- the npm scripts (dupes, lint:cpd, lint:cpd:ci) must not override it. Measured total is 4.77%, stable to the digit across repeated runs, so 6 leaves ~1.2pp of headroom: enough that a small refactor does not red the build, tight enough that a new duplicated screen does. ONLY EVER LOWER THIS. Was 10 until #74, then 8, then 6 with the jscpd 5 upgrade in #81 -- the earlier figures were measured on an inflated corpus, not on less duplicated code, so this is not a real improvement and should not be read as one. Ratchet down as duplication in screens/PDF templates is reduced (ADR-010); `tsx` alone is 11.48%, which is where the work is.
